dependencies.http_transport: stdlib urllib (no third-party HTTP client in use)

provenance.dirty_note: an uncommitted tree is recorded, not hidden: what is frozen is a commit identity plus a diff hash, not a claim of a clean checkout

A.decider: one plan request, then execution only
A.name: one-shot plan
A.rule: on verification failure, while the precondition still holds, repeat the identical skill/object/candidate at most per_action_extra_repeats times; terminate when a new action would be needed, the budget is spent, or the repeats fail

B.decider: the same model, one decision per skill boundary, on the freshest context

C.decider: as B, on a context with the detailed execution diagnostics, attempt history and verification summary removed

arms.identical_across_arms: goal source and its shared parse, skill catalogue, executor, verifier, budgets, candidate registry, scene, evaluator and scoring
arms.not_an_arm: the legacy full-plan+replan reference path stays available in code and may not be labelled one-shot planning (SPEC 11.2)

blind_review.empty_is_a_result: a batch with no contested items reports an empty blind review; predicates are not loosened to manufacture items
prohibitions: 不得由被试模型自评，也不得用模型生成的判定充当人审（SPEC 11.4）。记分为 model 的记录一律拒收。
不得为让比率好看而事后改本准则的判据、抽样集合或分母定义；要改只能改下一版 rubric_id 并重跑。
不得把 divided（两名审阅人分歧）条目折中、平均或由第三人推翻：分歧本身就是要报告的结果。
不得把未审条目当作 0 或当作'合理'：未审就是未审，分母必须点名。
blind_review.sampling: 100%：产物里 `needs_blind_review` 指名的每一条都要审，不是抽样；指针缺失（无证据可看）的条目记为 not_reviewable 并如实报告

budgets.per_case_overrides: the frozen task list's budget_profile, hashed with the rest

protections.note: mode A's bounded repeat of the identical skill/object/candidate is the pre-registered baseline rule (SPEC 11.2), not a strategy: B uses the same protection and the same attempt ceiling, and only differs in who decides to retry

also_required_to_claim.cost_reported: an improvement in success bought with a large cost increase is reported as such, not as a capability gain (SPEC 12.2)

gates.declared_in: SPEC 12.2 (本初稿建议值，正式测试前冻结)
gates.if_engineering_passes_and_gates_do_not: the conclusion is 持续决策闭环已实现，预期能力增益未证实, decided by the error distribution — not by widening the module count until the number moves

items.unit: paired mean difference of per-case rates

gates.status: 阶段目标，不是已达到的结果，也不是总体能力保证

prompts.note: the version string is what a manifest labels a prompt with; the hash is what proves the labelled text is still the text that gets sent

budget_estimate.status: an estimate for planning only; the limit that binds is per_episode_http_cap, and no estimate enters a denominator

run_matrix.execution_order: modes interleaved inside each (case, repeat): a provider that changes behaviour mid-batch perturbs all three arms of a pair equally (SPEC 11.2)
run_matrix.per_episode_budgets: the per-case `Budgets` in the frozen task list, not a number restated here; the http cap is the widest of them and is the only one quoted as an upper bound

pilot.purpose: measures the cost of one batch and the request count per episode before the formal run; its episodes are never folded into a formal rate
pilot.why: `--prereg` refuses any matrix but the formal one, so a pilot cannot run under the pre-registration and be mistaken for part of it; the shape is recorded here so the pilot that was run is checkable

run_matrix.seed_policy: repeat n reuses the case seed, so the scene is fixed; the model run is still an independent sample and is recorded by its own episode id and completion id (SPEC 11.1)

sampling.credential_policy: api_key_env names the variable; the value is in the environment or the gitignored .env and appears in no config, snapshot, prompt or log (SPEC 7)
sampling.effective_source: DeepSeekAdapter.sampling, recorded per run as model.sampling; the runner compares the live object against this block (SPEC 11.2: 固定 provider、实际模型标识、采样参数)
sampling.pricing_note: no rate is asserted for a provider whose price was not read from a source in this repository; requests and tokens are reported instead of an invented cost, and `api_cost_estimate` stays null until a price is configured (SPEC 11.4 成本指标)

spec.note: the SPEC is the only source of terms; this file records the numbers it left to be frozen, and where a value is the code's rather than the document's, the code is named as the source

statistics.aggregation: per case over its repeats first, then paired differences per case, bootstrapped over cases; three rollouts of one configuration are not three tasks (SPEC 11.1, 11.4)

bootstrap.note: the seed is fixed so the interval of a frozen report is reproducible rather than re-drawn on every render

statistics.claim_rule: only a paired difference whose 95% lower bound is above zero is worded as a supported gain; a point estimate that clears the bar with an interval crossing zero is worded 初步收益，证据不足
statistics.exclusions_permitted: none after the fact; an API error, a simulation crash, an unfired declared event and a wrong goal parse are reported as themselves (SPEC 11.4: 合法性排除规则必须事先冻结；不因任务难或事件未触发而事后删样本)
statistics.layering: clean / state_change / execution_deviation, and by object count, each with its own numerator and denominator
statistics.primary_metric: independent complete-task success rate judged by IndependentEvaluator against the hidden EvalSpec
